lines.text: A man in a paper hat is peeling a price tag off a shelf. He stuffs it in his apron.

lines.speaker: grocer
lines.text: We're CLOSED. No customers. Especially no small customers.

lines.speaker: grocer
lines.text: If nobody knows the prices, nobody can buy anything. And if nobody buys anything, nobody messes up my shelves!

lines.speaker: grocer
lines.text: You. I heard about you. Get out of my store.

lines.speaker: grocer
lines.text: YOU. You knocked over my cans last time!

lines.speaker: grocer
lines.text: Hands off my price tags!

lines.speaker: tadzio
lines.text: Your pocket is full of price tags.

lines.speaker: grocer
lines.text: ...It might be.
You stick the price tags back on the shelves, one by one. Beans: 2 dollars.
You line up the cans so every label faces front.

lines.speaker: grocer
lines.text: ...That's actually very neat.

lines.speaker: grocer
lines.text: Don't touch the pyramid of cans!

lines.speaker: grocer
lines.text: No running in the aisles!

lines.speaker: grocer
lines.text: Clean up on aisle EVERYWHERE!

lines.speaker: grocer
lines.text: My shelves! My beautiful shelves!

lines.speaker: grocer
lines.text: Prices on. Shelves neat. Fine. FINE. You can be a customer.

lines.speaker: grocer
lines.text: Here. The shiniest apple in the store. No charge. Don't tell anyone.
You got a shiny apple.

lines.speaker: grocer
lines.text: Hmph! I'm closing early.
The Grocer flips the sign to CLOSED and stomps into the back room.

lines.speaker: grocer
lines.text: Every price is on. I checked twice. Don't touch anything.
A shelf of cans. Beans, soup, more beans. There isn't a single price tag.
Apples, oranges and pears in little crates. The price signs are blank.
A freezer full of ice cream. It hums. Somebody wrote NO in the frost.
The checkout counter. The cash register says CLOSED in green letters.
A glowing sign of a carrot and an apple. It buzzes a little.
